acceptanceCriteria.statement: One pipeline: the ray law has ONE definition under src/ that both front-ends import. New module `src/worldengine/base/ejectaRays.js` exports `rayBrightnessOf(condition)` — the lab's law verbatim: clamp01(1 − erosion) × (condition.atmosphere ? 0 : 1) with erosion = surfaceHistory.erosion ?? surfaceHistory.erosionLevel ?? 0 — plus `RAY_COUNT = 6` and `RAY_SHARP = 8`. `labCore.deriveUniforms` calls it (the inline expression at labCore.js:785 is gone; the line rides in place). The crater driver block (craterDeck.js:116-197) reads the CONDITION directly — `uRayBrightness: scalar(rayBrightnessOf(condition), { gate: EJECTA_GATE })`, the same shape as its `rel = craterRelevanceOf(condition)` one step earlier — plus `uRayCount: RAY_COUNT`, `uRaySharp: RAY_SHARP`. `craterUniformsFrom` and its frozen `CRATERS_OFF` (craterUniforms.js:88-97) are UNCHANGED: the ray law is a pure condition function and must not inherit the crater schedule's fired/not-fired branch. The lab's state literal (world-engine-lab.html:1175-1176) takes the two constants from the import; `uRayBrightness` is NOT added to either LAB_BINDING (the apron's precedent) — `state.rayBrightness` keeps its single writer at :2042. `CRATER_DECK_UNIFORMS` (craterDeck.js:282-285) and `ROCKY_SURFACE_UNIFORMS` (rockySurface.js:360-374) gain exactly the three names; tests/driver-pack-rockysurface.test.js:1097's declared count moves 23 → 26 on that one line (annotated per its own convention) and nothing else in either sibling suite changes. Spine conformance (CLAUDE.md Rule 15 → docs/WORKSTREAMS/world-engine-history-program-2026-06-27/SPINE-CONFORMANCE.md): (1) driver connectivity — the law reads only `condition.atmosphere` and `surfaceHistory.erosion ?? erosionLevel`, no archetype-string routing; (2) named consumer — `rayField` (height.glsl.js:2190-2206), called at planetShaders.glsl.js:516, folded into `rayBright` at :787; (3) taxonomy registration — no new lab control, preset or feature key is authored, `tests/planet-archetypes.test.js` green unchanged.
